title: Linden Memberships Collections Parameters
content:
Unpaid dues on Linden Memberships are governed by four figures per tier, maintained by patient financial services:

- **Payment grace**: the calendar days after a dues due date before the membership becomes past due.
- **Termination period**: the calendar days a membership may remain past due before it is terminated.
- **Reinstatement fee**: the fee, in US dollars, to reinstate a past-due membership.
- **Rejoin waiting period**: the calendar months after a termination for non-payment before the patient may enroll again.

## Parameters by tier

| Tier | Payment grace (days) | Termination period (days past due) | Reinstatement fee (USD) | Rejoin waiting period (months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Linden Connect Virtual Membership | 5 | 30 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Linden Essential Membership | 10 | 45 | 25.00 | 6 |
| Linden Family Membership | 10 | 45 | 50.00 | 6 |
| Linden Plus Membership | 10 | 45 | 25.00 | 6 |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership | 10 | 60 | 100.00 | 12 |
| Linden Executive Health Membership | 10 | 60 | 0.00 | 12 |

## Notes

1. The Linden Connect Virtual Membership has the shortest payment grace (5 days) and termination period (30 days), charges no reinstatement fee and has a rejoin waiting period of 0 months.
2. The Linden Executive Health Membership charges a reinstatement fee of 0.00 while carrying a 12-month rejoin waiting period.
3. The Linden Premier Concierge Membership carries the highest reinstatement fee, 100.00.
